tables.why: The runner's own record of applied files. Only the migration role reads or writes it
The idempotency helper finds a key at step 2 of module-map 6.1, before Authorise and before the record's scope is known; only the helper reads it (code-house-rules 12.4 "Storage")

Read with its key row at step 2 of module-map 6.1, before Authorise; it holds no restricted value, and a replay is answered only after the access checks pass again (code-house-rules 12.4 "Storage", "Replay")

Written by the helper before Authorise; a kept refused request is protected by encrypting every restricted value and by the read rule of the operations view, not by row-level security (code-house-rules 12.4 "Storage", "Changed content")
